card.name: Words just before a change or effect
card.fires_on: Words that come right before a noun describing a change or effect: 'on' after 'Effect(s)' in headings, 'dose' or 'dosage' before 'adjustment', 'increase' or 'reduction', and 'the' after verbs like change or enhance.

modes.label: Dose before change
modes.description: The word dose or dosage right before a change term such as adjustment, increase or reduction.
modes.example: particularly during treatment initiation and<< dose>> adjustment. Discontinue OLINVYK

modes.label: Effect(s) on heading
modes.description: The word 'on' in section headings that begin with Effect or Effects.
modes.example: 5.3 Effects<< on>> Reproduction Based on published reports, meth

modes.label: The after change verb
modes.description: The word 'the' after a verb of changing or enhancing, before the thing affected.
modes.example: do not change<< the>> basic structure of DNA, and a gene
